title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 MAY)
summary: The post presents a comprehensive list of feature improvement ideas submitted to Dynamics 365 Business Central for May 2025, organized by functional areas including finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, and more. It serves as a resource for developers, consultants, and users seeking proposed enhancements across all Business Central modules.
key_points: Over 80 improvement suggestions span multiple areas: data migration, development tools, financial management, inventory, manufacturing, sales, purchasing, service management, and administration.
Development-focused ideas include enhancements to CSVBuffer, Variant functions, Bank Account Reconciliation, Edit in Excel, and AppSource delivery options.
Finance suggestions address VAT reporting, Intrastat improvements, bank reconciliation features, and currency handling in journal posting.
Cross-module ideas cover Copilot integration for business rules assessment, support for vision-enabled OpenAI models, and improved lock timeout tracking.
Regional and localization improvements include EU VAT validation, E-Documents enhancements, and country-specific reporting like OSS for Austria.
features: Edit in Excel for Sales and Purchase Prices
E-Documents support for other line types
Intrastat statistical value with item charges

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the purpose of the post as a curated collection of community-sourced feature suggestions for Business Central improvement.
